A packet is resolved ONLY by an entry here carrying a `decision_ref` into state/DECISIONS.jsonl, because catalogue disposition is charter power G1 — ADHIKĀRIN's alone. No KĀRAKA, and no author of this file, may resolve a packet by writing a justification into it. The block is EMPTY at authoring because no such ruling had been made; X-05 therefore reports 23 unresolved findings, which is the true state, not a guard defect.
